text:
maria: Spinning up a spot GPU pool rotation in us-east-1 to reclaim idle GPUs. Terraform plan is ready but Conftest blocks the plan with the `no-spot-pools-without-override` rule. Need a short-lived override/exception during the maintenance window. Details below.

devin: Can you paste the PR and the snippet? Also what is the freeze window? :eyes:

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inc/infrastructure/pull/4321
Snippet:
```
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "spot_rotation" {
  name = "spot-rotation-us-east-1"
  instance_type = "p4d.24xlarge"
  capacity = 20
  spot = true
}
```

conftest-bot: Rejected: policy `no-spot-pools-without-override` failed. Required metadata: `policy_approval` tag with ticket id, and `conftest_override` annotation.

sam: We're in the weekly Infra freeze window 2026-02-08 17:00-20:00 UTC. Overrides must be approved by infra leads. What's the justification and rollback plan?

maria: Justification: reclaim underutilized spot capacity from old test clusters and rotate instances to refresh kernels. Rollback: revert to previous module and scale down new pool, or failover to dedicated-burst pool. Downside: some pod restarts during rotation, but canary is small.

jordan: Risk assessment: spot termination could affect ~10% of active jobs during rotation. If we do a canary (10% traffic) and monitor cpu/gpu reclaim metrics, should be ok. I'm +1 to approve if we add audit tags.

lee: Can we add a TTL on the override so it auto-expires? Conftest should enforce auto-expire for exceptions.

devin: Conftest doesn't do TTL itself; our gitops pipeline supports `envdrift/override` annotations that the policy engine considers if present with a ticket id and expiry in RFC3339.

maria: I'm proposing to add this block to the Terraform module:
```
variable "policy_override" {
  type = string
  default = "conftest_override:ENGINFRA-412;expires:2026-02-08T21:00:00Z"
}
```

conftest-bot: Note: override format recognized. Will still require explicit approval in thread from infra leads and an associated JIRA ticket.

sam: ENGINFRA-412 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGINFRA-412 — description: spot rotation us-east-1, short-lived exception.

jordan: I approve (monitoring: grafana/dashboards/gpu-pool-rotate, alert: gpu-pool-rotation-failed). I'll be on-call for the window.

devin: Added `policy_override` to PR and updated README. Also added a `canary_percentage = 10` flag to the helm chart.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: infrastructure/spot-rotation -> canary 10% at 2026-02-08T17:30:00Z. CI: passed. Conftest: override tag present.

conftest-bot: Override accepted for ENGINFRA-412. Audit requirement: include `conftest_override=ENGINFRA-412` tag in merged commit. Auto-expiry at 2026-02-08T21:00:00Z.

kate: Cost note: spot p4d is cheaper but unpredictable. Estimate savings: ~$18k/month for this pool vs dedicated.

maria: I'll merge after @sam final signoff and add the audit tag. Will post status updates in this thread during the window.

sam: Final signoff :thumbsup: Merge when ready, ping if anything unexpected.

maria: Merged and tagged `conftest_override=ENGINFRA-412`. Canary started, monitoring now. Will update with metrics in 15m.

deploy-bot: Canary health: OK (90m). No alerts. Proceeding to 50% rollout.

maria: Rotation complete, no regression. Override will auto-expire at 2026-02-08T21:00:00Z. Closing thread.
